A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same RSIR research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–H. All 26 pages were compared; pages 6–26 have identical extracted text and rendered images.

before.justification: v1 reports original recommendation experiments, including benchmark comparisons, fidelity ablations, recursive iterations, runtime measurements, and appendix noise-robustness results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons and supplementary experiments in Appendices C, D, and F.

M1.justification: The recursive training loop, hybrid candidate sampling, fidelity check, and dataset expansion in Section 3 and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. The fine-tuning, retraining, and clustering-based retrieval variants are also retained unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate sequential recommendation on Amazon Beauty, Sports, Toys, and Yelp. The supplementary semantic-ID and injected-noise scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 6 retain the same comparisons using SASRec, CL4SRec, and HSTU with Reordering, Insertion, ASReP, DiffuASR, and DR4SR. Comparator membership in the supplementary and runtime comparisons is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The 5-core preprocessing, leave-one-out evaluation, metrics, maximum 1000 training epochs, early-stopping patience of 20, and hyperparameter searches are unchanged. The appendices retain the same supplementary evaluation protocols.

E4.justification: The fidelity ablation, hyperparameter sweeps, recursive-iteration analyses, weak-to-strong transfer, generated-data analyses, clustering tests, and noise-robustness experiments are identical across versions.

E5.justification: The p-value < 0.05 statements in Tables 1, 2, 6, and 8 are unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, or confidence intervals.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are retained, including Tables 1–14 and the plotted results. For example, Table 1 reports the same Amazon-Sport SASRec Recall@10 values of 0.0474 for Base and 0.0512 for RSIR in both versions.

T1.justification: The complexity derivations, manifold assumptions, implicit-regularization argument, recursive error bound, and proofs in Section 4 and Appendices D–E are unchanged. Appendix G's entropy definition is also unchanged; Equation 6 merely moves from page 4 to page 5.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about self-improvement without external data or teachers, implicit regularization, cumulative gains, and weak-to-strong transfer.

C2.justification: Both versions give the same interpretations based on data densification, landscape smoothing, and fidelity filtering. Discussions of leakage noise, eventual saturation or degradation, and scalability retain the same qualifications.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the anonymous.4open.science/r/RSIR-7C5B code link with the GitHub repository USTC-StarTeam/RSIR, changing the reported code-access destination. Implementation descriptions, hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, and data-access information are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works, the bibliography, and the paper's positioning relative to prior augmentation and self-improvement methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds Wei Guo as a corresponding author and replaces the preprint footer with ICML 2026 proceedings and copyright information. The scientific prose, terminology, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page abstract, introduction, and footnote layout changes, with resulting text and equation reflow through page 5. Figures and tables retain their designs and contents; pages 6–26 render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the scientific argument, experiments, results, proofs, and appendices. Its changes update an existing code pointer and publication/contact metadata and modestly reflow the opening pages. Both versions already provide a code link, and no additional implementation content is documented, so these edits leave overall paper quality materially unchanged.
